channel.title: Tejas Mahajan — Blog
channel.description: Technical notes on machine learning, AI security, computational biology, and systems, by Tejas Mahajan.

item.title: Why synthetic data can still leak private records
item.description: A walkthrough of SyntheticShield, a research prototype that audits synthetic-data generators for memorization and membership leakage using canary records and membership tests.

item.title: How RAGGuard filters sensitive context before it reaches the model
item.description: A walkthrough of RAGGuard, a research prototype that sits between a retriever and a generator, classifies each chunk, and measures leakage against an unfiltered RAG baseline.

item.title: QoS-aware memory scheduling for CPU–AI co-execution
item.description: How FairDRAM, a research prototype built on Ramulator 2, gives latency-sensitive CPU requests bounded priority when an accelerator is flooding memory bandwidth.
